purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt/Seikyu-sho) processing – specifically a combined-insurance claim aggregation/print program for monthly billing
purpose.summary: SOKATU4020 is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system. It processes and aggregates medical insurance claim records (Seikyu-sho) for combined-insurance patients, reading temporary claim files, updating claim DB files, and producing printed output. The program handles various public-expense insurance categories and their billing rules.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (35 copybooks) referencing ORCA-specific include files
52 CALL statements indicating modular subprogram architecture
Indexed file I/O with DYNAMIC access mode
LINE SEQUENTIAL files for update and error output
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
Extensive inline revision history in comments spanning 2005–2013
REDEFINES usage for hospital name/address fields
OCCURS tables for public-expense insurance code grouping (WRK-2007-AREA, WRK-2010-AREA)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually Japanese EUC-JP encoding, appearing as mojibake. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 134576 bytes total. The program is clearly production medical billing software from the well-known open-source JMA ORCA system. Fixed-format with 28 lines slightly over 72 columns (likely continuation or long literals).
